description: Pandas helps work with data arranged in rows and columns. Learn to select, filter, group and check a small fictional score table with clear Python examples. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain read by label with loc
Explain read by position with iloc
learningObjectives: Practise sort rows by a value

seo.title: Pandas Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Pandas with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
